text:
Alexa: thinking out loud — we should add an "economy pathing" layer that prefers cheaper model variants for trial/low-tier customers, but remains region-aware (avoid cross-region fallbacks unless latency acceptable).
Mike: +1. can we make it cost-per-token threshold driven? e.g., if estimated cost > X then route to 'economy' variant.
Jia: telemetry question — how do we estimate token cost pre-response? do we use prompt-length histogram + model token-rate? we need to emit expected_cost in traces.
Sara: billing note: if we switch tiers automatically we must ensure invoices reflect actual variant used. Also need opt-out for customers on metered plans.
Tom: UX: Console should show a simple toggle per project: "Enable economy pathing (auto-fallback to cheaper variants)" and a dropdown for policy scope (global/project/route). Add a small per-route override in advanced settings.
Alexa: implementation debate: proxy-level (fast, per-request) vs control-plane decision (centralized, easier audit). My leaning: proxy does fast evaluation, control plane supplies policy + weights.
Mike: agree. proxy can cache policy for a minute. proxy needs a small scoring function: score = latency_penalty(region) + lambda * cost_delta + alpha * quality_penalty_estimate. If score < threshold -> pick economy variant.
Jia: example scoring snippet I sketched:

```
# pseudo
score = cost_delta * 1.2 + region_penalty(region, client_region) * 2.0 - quality_margin_est
if score < 0.5:
  route = economy_variant
else:
  route = baseline
```

we should emit the score to telemetry.
Sara: +1 on telemetry, also track "variance from expected cost" per request for first 24h after rollout. billing team will subscribe to that stream.
Tom: Console wire idea: show per-route a sparklines of "% routed to economy" and a small knob for "max token-cost savings allowed". default 20%.
Alexa: edge cases: long streaming responses — economy quantized models might increase latency/stalls. we should detect streaming sessions and avoid economy unless explicit.
Mike: deploy-bot reports: deploy finished for proxy-economy-heuristic branch to stag earlier today. experiment flag is `economy_pathing_v1`.
deploy-bot: Deployed proxy:economy-pathing v1 to staging at 2026-03-18T13:05Z (build 4591) :rocket:
Jia: next steps I propose: 1) add expected_cost and routing_score to traces, 2) add per-project opt-out flag in control plane, 3) wire console toggle + %savings knob. I'll own telemetry.
Sara: I'll prepare billing mapping doc and opt-out enforcement. Tom can you mock the UI by EOD?
Tom: yes, will post mock in #design by 5p.
Alexa: mike/jia pair to ship proxy changes behind `economy_pathing_v1`, start canary 1% then 10%. add regression alert if latency P95 climbs > 10ms.
Mike: noted. will add rollout playbook to the PR.
Sara: also add invoice testcases to e2e so we don't leak cheaper variant usage into wrong SKU.
Alexa: great. thanks everyone — will sync on Monday AM to review canary metrics. :thumbsup:
